text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: elevated 5xx rate detected on inference-gateway (gateway-prod). Spike started ~6161616158. Symptoms: burst of 502/504 and increased timeouts. Pager sent to oncall.

alex: i'm on it — paging sam (primary oncall). seeing cluster error rate up in the dashboards.

sam: picking up. what's the current customer impact? any degrading healthchecks?

alex: customers reporting increased latencies and some failed inference requests. error budget burn visible for a couple high-traffic routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. 5xx mostly 502 from upstream.

jordan: adding logs — from gateway access logs showing retries multiplying requests to backend clusters.

jordan: snippet of access log (gateway):
```
[2026-03-15T12:02:05Z] "POST /v1/generate" 502 0 0.012 "-" "service->embed-service-03" retry_count=3
[2026-03-15T12:02:06Z] "POST /v1/generate" 502 0 0.045 "-" "service->embed-service-03" retry_count=5
```

eli: that retry_count jump looks bad. Could be a route-level retries policy combined with a fanout to multiple clusters (weighted) causing amplification.

maria: i can see a config change rolled ~6161616000 — recent envoy route change to add a failover cluster and enable `retry_policy` for upstream 5xx. i'll pull the diff.

maria: diff (configmap envoy-gateway-routes):
```
- route:
-   cluster: embed-service
+ route:
+   weighted_clusters:
+     clusters:
+       - name: embed-service
+         weight: 70
+       - name: embed-service-03
+         weight: 30
+   retry_policy:
+     retry_on: 5xx,connect,refused_stream
+     num_retries: 3
```

sam: ah. weighted fanout + retries => each frontend request can spawn multiple retries to both clusters. if embed-service-03 is flaky, retries duplicate load and cause cascading 5xx. we should disable retries at the gateway immediately.

alex: agreed. quick mitigation plan:
- disable `retry_policy` on the route (gateway) to stop amplification
- reduce weight of embed-service-03 to 0 (drain) so traffic moves to stable cluster
- check circuit-breaker / connection pool on embed-service

opsbot: Deploy pipeline triggered: `deploy/envoy-gateway/patch` — approving?

sam: do it. i'll prepare the rollback patch. tagging @maria for apply and @eli to monitor.

maria: applying temp patch now — removing retry_policy and setting embed-service-03 weight=0. patching configmap and triggering envoy hot-reload.

maria: kubectl commands run:
```
kubectl get configmap envoy-gateway -o yaml > /tmp/envoy.yaml
# edit to remove retry_policy and set weight
kubectl apply -f /tmp/envoy.yaml
kubectl rollout restart deploy/envoy-gateway
```

alex: monitoring graphs — 1 min after apply, 5xx rate down by ~60% on /v1/generate. latency normalizing. :white_check_mark:

eli: checking backend metrics — embed-service-03 5xx rate is high, connection errors spike.

jordan: heap of repeated upstream errors in embed-service-03 logs around 12:01Z. likely partial degradation after the config change.

jordan: logs from embed-service-03:
```
ERROR 2026-03-15T12:01:58Z handler.go:123 upstream timeout: context deadline exceeded
ERROR 2026-03-15T12:02:04Z server.go:78 connection refused
```

sam: good catch. mitigation working. next steps:
- keep retries disabled for 30 mins
- keep weight 0 until embed-service-03 healthy
- escalate to infra team owning embed-service-03 for postmortem
- consider adding a canary and health check gating to route weight changes

maria: NIT: should we also tighten circuit-breaker limits to avoid head-of-line resource exhaustion? maybe lower max connections temporarily.

alex: yes, but that's less urgent than stopping amplification. we'll open a follow-up for CB tuning.

opsbot: Route patch rollout completed. Change id: rp-20260315-12-03. :hammer:

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Mitigation observed: gateway 5xx count dropped to baseline within 90s. Customer impact reduced. Keep monitoring for 20m.

eli: monitoring shows small tail of errors -> probably retries draining. charts show healthy after ~4 mins.

sam: filing incident ticket and will assign owners. who owns embed-service-03?

jordan: infra team `ml-embed` owns that. i'll ping them and attach logs.

jordan: @ml-embed-team please investigate embed-service-03 degradation around 12:00Z. suspected cause: increased duplicated traffic from gateway due to retry_policy + weighted cluster.

alex: quick RCA notes to add to incident ticket: recent route change enabled retries and added weighted cluster. embed-service-03 was unhealthy; combined effect caused retry amplification and 502s. Immediate mitigation: remove retry_policy, set weight 0.

sam: postmortem action items:
- revert the route change to a canary and gate weight by healthchecks
- add test that simulates partial cluster failure and validates retries don't amplify fanout
- add an alert for retry amplification (retry_count per request > 2)
- run load test against gateway with retries enabled before rollout

maria: i'll create the follow-up tasks and link to the config PR. starting a postmortem doc.

opsbot: oncall handoff reminder — sam will stay on until 13:00Z. next oncall is eli.

sam: staying as owner until wrap. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
